newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Drunken Russian shepherd kills four, hangs himself.
newsitem.headline: Drunken Russian shepherd kills four, hangs himself.

text.p: A drunken shepherd shot dead four people and wounded six others before killing himself, Itar-Tass news agency said on Sunday.
The shepherd turned his double-barrelled shotgun on fellow-villagers in the southern Siberian village of Balagansk on Saturday after getting into a drunken quarrel with them.
He then mounted a horse and galloped off firing into the air. He later hanged himself with the horse's bridle, Tass said.
